# routeros_ip_reverse_proxy (Resource)




<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `___id___` (Number) <em>Resource ID type (.id / name). This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___path___` (String) <em>Resource path for CRUD operations. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `certificate` (String) Certificate presented for this entry. When it is `none`, the certificate of the `www-ssl` service is used.
- `comment` (String)
- `disabled` (Boolean)
- `ip_address` (String) IP address of the backend server that receives the proxied connections.
- `port` (Number) TCP port of the backend server that receives the proxied connections.
- `sni` (String) Server Name Indication the incoming TLS connection must carry for this entry to be used. The reverse proxy listens on TCP 443, so the `www-ssl` service has to be disabled or moved to another port.
- `vrf` (String) The VRF table this resource operates on.

### Read-Only

- `dynamic` (Boolean) Configuration item created by software, not by management interface. It is not exported, and cannot be directly modified.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
